post.description: Where players go in drafts for a scoring format and league size, this season or any season back to 2007.

format.description:
Draft format. Default ppr.

Provider reference: allowed values ["standard", "ppr", "half-ppr", "2qb", "dynasty", "rookie"]; default "ppr".

limit.description:
Return only the top N. Omit for the whole list (the site sends it in full).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500.

position.description:
Default ALL.

Provider reference: allowed values ["ALL", "QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "K", "DST"]; default "ALL".

teams.description:
League size; changes only adp_formatted (round.pick). Default 12.

Provider reference: allowed values ["8", "10", "12", "14"]; default 12.

year.description:
Draft season. Omit for the current season. History starts in 2007 for standard, 2010 for ppr, 2014 for 2qb and rookie, 2015 for dynasty and 2018 for half-ppr; a season without data is not_found.

Provider reference: minimum 2007; maximum 2100.

200.description:
Average draft position from Fantasy Football Calculator mock drafts via GET https://fantasyfootballcalculator.com/api/v1/adp/{format}?teams&year&position: overall ADP, round.pick, earliest and latest pick, standard deviation and times drafted per player, with the number of drafts and the date window they cover.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `players` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `adp` | number | Average overall pick. |
| `adp_formatted` | string | Average pick as round.pick for the league size, for example 1.03. |
| `bye_week` | number | Null for free agents. |
| `high` | number | Earliest overall pick. |
| `low` | number | Latest overall pick. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `player_id` | number | Fantasy Football Calculator player id. |
| `position` | string |  |
| `stdev` | number |  |
| `team` | string | Team abbreviation, or FA. |
| `times_drafted` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: This week's start/sit order and projected points for a position in standard, PPR, half-PPR or 2-QB scoring, or long-term dynasty and rookie rankings.

format.description:
standard (non-PPR), ppr, half-ppr or 2qb weekly rankings with projections; dynasty or rookie (dynasty rookie) rankings. 2qb projections use standard scoring. Default ppr.

Provider reference: allowed values ["standard", "ppr", "half-ppr", "2qb", "dynasty", "rookie"]; default "ppr".

limit.description:
Return only the top N. Omit for everything the page lists: the whole table for dynasty, rookie and positions with under 50 players, the site's top 50 for other season-long pages (reported as partial coverage).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500.

position.description:
ALL (overall), QB, RB, WR, TE, K, DST (team defense) or FLX (RB/WR/TE). Rookie rankings have no K or DST. Season-long pages stop at the site's top 50, so ALL and FLX cover fewer players than the per-position pages together; call QB, RB, WR, TE, K and DST for depth.

Provider reference: allowed values ["ALL", "QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "K", "DST", "FLX"].

200.description:
Fantasy Football Calculator rankings for one scoring format and position, parsed from the server-rendered page https://fantasyfootballcalculator.com/rankings/{format}/{position}: rank, team, bye week and, for the season-long formats, this week's projected fantasy points; dynasty and rookie rankings carry age instead. Season-long rankings are always the site's current week, echoed as week, and the site publishes only its top 50 per season-long page (the per-position pages reach deeper than ALL); dynasty and rookie pages are complete.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `players` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `age` | number | Dynasty and rookie rankings only; null elsewhere and for team defenses. |
| `bye_week` | number | Null for free agents. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `player_url` | string |  |
| `position` | string |  |
| `projected_points` | number | Projected fantasy points this week in the requested scoring (the site's Proj. FP, from RotoWire projections). Null for dynasty and rookie rankings. |
| `rank` | number |  |
| `team` | string | Team abbreviation, or FA. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
